# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 14 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Tells Seth of Paradise

---

**1** 'When God formed me from the dust of the earth and breathed into me the breath of life, he led me into paradise and showed me all the fruits of the trees.'

**2** 'God commanded me and Eve to eat freely of all the fruits, but not to eat from one tree that was in the middle of paradise — the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.'

**3** 'God commanded the angels to serve me and to worship me in the sight of God.'

**4** 'At that command, all the angels worshiped me — all except the devil. For this he was cast out of heaven, and he turned his malice against me.'

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
